_comment: Publisher check (pipeline/classify/INSTRUCTIONS_publishers.md): one row per channel that is a person's own channel or a publisher whose channel name was all the triage had. ok=false puts the collection at tier 1 with 'affiliation not verified' on the card; verified=true needs an institutional page tying the person to the institution. Edit by hand; the build reads it.
